processes.VSM_InitializeWIP:
<Process Name="VSM_InitializeWIP" BeginStepID="2" Description="按 VSM_InitialWIPTable 在仿真初始化时按计算批次创建初始在制品；每个实体由 BatchUnitQuantity 表示工件件数，尾批可以小于20件；然后送入统一分流节点。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName"></Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Search" Name="遍历初始WIP记录" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="CollectionType">TableRows</Property>
        <Property Name="EntityType">DefaultEntity</Property>
        <Property Name="ObjectInstanceName"></Property>
        <Property Name="ObjectType"></Property>
        <Property Name="ObjectListName"></Property>
        <Property Name="QueueStateName">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TableName">VSM_InitialWIPTable</Property>
        <Property Name="SearchRelatedRowsOnly">False</Property>
        <Property Name="OwnerType">AssociatedObject</Property>
        <Property Name="OwnerObject">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NodeListName"></Property>
        <Property Name="TransporterListName"></Property>
        <Property Name="NodeName"></Property>
        <Property Name="NetworkName">
          <Value>Global</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="ResourceType">AssociatedObject</Property>
        <Property Name="ResourceObject">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="SearchType">Forward</Property>
        <Property Name="MatchCondition">VSM_InitialWIPTable.BatchEntityCount > 0</Property>
        <Property Name="SearchExpression">0.0</Property>
        <Property Name="SaveSearchExpressionSum">
          <Value>Token.ReturnValue</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="Limit">Infinity</Property>
        <Property Name="StartingIndex"></Property>
        <Property Name="EndingIndex"></Property>
        <Property Name="SaveIndexFound">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="SaveNumberFound">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="CopyOverTableRowReferences">True</Property>
        <Property Name="SetTableRowConflictResolution">Replace</Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilNewTokenProcessingCompleted</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Found" Type="Alternate" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Create" Name="按计算批次创建实体" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="CreateType">NewObject</Property>
        <Property Name="OriginalEntityObject">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="EntityType">DefaultEntity</Property>
        <Property Name="TokenAssociatedObject"></Property>
        <Property Name="TokenContextObject"></Property>
        <Property Name="NumberToCreate">VSM_InitialWIPTable.BatchEntityCount</Property>
        <Property Name="SaveCreatedEntityReference">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilNewTokenProcessingCompleted</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Created" Type="Alternate" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="初始化实体业务属性" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_InitialWIPTable.ProductType</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductionBatchState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">"WIP:" + VSM_InitialWIPTable.WIPRecordId</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ReleaseTimeHoursState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_InitialWIPTable.ReleaseTimeHours</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_TrayIDState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_InitialWIPTable.TrayID</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_InitialWIPTable.BatchUnitQuantity</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_InitialLeftUnitCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_InitialLeftUnitCount + Math.If(VSM_InitialWIPTable.ProductType == "Left", VSM_InitialWIPTable.BatchUnitQuantity, 0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_InitialRightUnitCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_InitialRightUnitCount + Math.If(VSM_InitialWIPTable.ProductType == "Right", VSM_InitialWIPTable.BatchUnitQuantity, 0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="6" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Transfer" Name="送入初始WIP分流节点" ID="5">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="EntityType">AssociatedObject</Property>
        <Property Name="EntityObject">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="FromType">FreeSpace</Property>
        <Property Name="ToType">Node</Property>
        <Property Name="NodeName">Transfer_InitialWIP</Property>
        <Property Name="ExternalNodeName"></Property>
        <Property Name="StationName">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="ContainerName">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="FacilityName"></Property>
        <Property Name="OutboundLinkPreference">Default</Property>
        <Property Name="OutboundLinkRule">ShortestPath</Property>
        <Property Name="OutboundLinkName"></Property>
        <Property Name="FlowRegulatorName">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="PathPlannerName">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="RandomNumberStream">0</Property>
        <Property Name="FailIfBlocked">False</Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilTransferred</Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记初始库存来源" Description="登记初始库存来源；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="6">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_InitialWIPTable.SourceRow</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received + ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="5" />
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

    <Step Type="Decide" Name="需求行仍存在" Description="需求行仍存在；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="4">

    <Step Type="Decide" Name="需求已到期" Description="需求已到期；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="5">

    <Step Type="Assign" Name="转到下日需求" Description="转到下日需求；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="7">

            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">

              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>

            <Properties>

              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_Out_FGInventory[VSM_AllocStock].SourceRow].FGStagingOut</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[VSM_Out_FGInventory[VSM_AllocStock].SourceRow].FGStagingOut+VSM_AllocUnits</Property>

            </Properties>
            <Properties>

            <Properties>

            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_ShippedRightUnitCount</Value>

              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_ShippedRightUnitCount+Math.If(VSM_AllocProduct == 2,VSM_AllocUnits,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>

            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">

              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_FGLeftAvailable-Math.If(VSM_AllocProduct == 1,VSM_AllocUnits,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_FGRightAvailable</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_FGRightAvailable-Math.If(VSM_AllocProduct == 2,VSM_AllocUnits,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_FGStagingWIP</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_FGStagingWIP-VSM_AllocUnits</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">

              </Property>

              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_FGStagingLeftWIP</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_FGStagingLeftWIP-Math.If(VSM_AllocProduct == 1,VSM_AllocUnits,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_FGStagingRightWIP</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_FGStagingRightWIP-Math.If(VSM_AllocProduct == 2,VSM_AllocUnits,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>

      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="11" />

    <Step Type="AddRow" Name="新增交付分配" Description="新增交付分配；建立新输出行并绑定当前令牌/库存实体，后续Assign冻结事件时状态值。" ID="11">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="ObjectType">Token</Property>
        <Property Name="ObjectOrElement">
          <Value></Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TableName">VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation</Property>

            <Properties>

                <Value>VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation.StockRow</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_AllocStock</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation.Units</Value>

              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_AllocUnits</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation.OnTime</Value>

            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation.CTKnown</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_Out_FGInventory[VSM_AllocStock].StartTime>=0,1,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation.ShipmentTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation.DueTime</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_DemandLedger[VSM_AllocDemand].DueTime</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation.ManufacturingCT</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_Out_FGInventory[VSM_AllocStock].StartTime>=0,VSM_Out_FGInventory[VSM_AllocStock].FinishTime-VSM_Out_FGInventory[VSM_AllocStock].StartTime,-1)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation.FGWait</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow-VSM_Out_FGInventory[VSM_AllocStock].FinishTime</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation.EndToEnd</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_Out_FGInventory[VSM_AllocStock].StartTime>=0,TimeNow-VSM_Out_FGInventory[VSM_AllocStock].StartTime,-1)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation.InitialRemainingDelivery</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_Out_FGInventory[VSM_AllocStock].StartTime<0,TimeNow,-1)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation.Version</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_ModelVersion</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation.Replication</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Run.ReplicationNumber</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_Out_ShipmentAllocation.RandomnessDisabled</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(Run.RandomnessDisabled,1,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="13" />

    <Step Type="Assign" Name="跳过耗尽库存" Description="跳过耗尽库存；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="13">

        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_AllocStock</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">Math.If(VSM_Out_FGInventory[VSM_AllocStock].RemainingUnits == 0,VSM_Out_FGInventory[VSM_AllocStock].NextRow,VSM_AllocStock)</Property>

        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_DemandRightCursor</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_AllocProduct==2,VSM_AllocDemand,VSM_DemandRightCursor)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_FGLeftHead</Value>
              </Property>

            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_FGRightHead</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.If(VSM_AllocProduct==2,VSM_AllocStock,VSM_FGRightHead)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_AllocProduct</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_AllocProduct+1</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>

    <Step Type="Decide" Name="继续右件分配" Description="继续右件分配；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="15">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="DecideType">ConditionBased</Property>
        <Property Name="ConditionOrProbability">VSM_AllocProduct <= 2</Property>
        <Property Name="RandomNumberStream">0</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="True" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
      <Exit Name="False" Type="Alternate" NextID="16" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Fire" Name="通知库存分配完成" Description="通知库存分配完成；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="16">

        <Property Name="EventName">VSM_InventoryAllocated</Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>
processes.VSM_OnEnterFGStagingWIP:
<Process Name="VSM_OnEnterFGStagingWIP" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="进入成品后建立数量账本/FIFO链；初始成品从0可用；按剩余件数分配，全部交付后才退出物理实体。">

    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>

            </Properties>
            <Properties>

            <Properties>

    <Step Type="AddRow" Name="新增成品库存" Description="新增成品库存；建立新输出行并绑定当前令牌/库存实体，后续Assign冻结事件时状态值。" ID="5">

        <Property Name="ObjectType">AssociatedObject</Property>

        <Property Name="TableName">VSM_Out_FGInventory</Property>

        <Property Name="AddRowCondition"></Property>

          <Value>VSM_Out_FGInventory.SourceRow</Value>

processes.VSM_OnProductionRelease:
<Process Name="VSM_OnProductionRelease" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="两轮生产释放：每轮先L6000后R3200；独立工单P1/P2；单位件；来源行号12–15。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName">Output@Source_ProductionRelease.Entered</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记释放序号" Description="登记释放序号；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_ReleaseSequence</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_ReleaseSequence + VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="识别工单产品" Description="识别工单产品；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">12 + 2*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) + Math.If(VSM_ReleaseSequence - 9200*Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/9200) <= 6000,0,1)</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_EntityUnitQuantity</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Product</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ProductionBatchState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].SourceID</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_ReleaseTimeHoursState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>ModelEntity.VSM_TrayIDState</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">Math.Floor((VSM_ReleaseSequence-1)/VSM_EntityUnitQuantity)+1</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="登记工单下达" Description="登记工单下达；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].Received+ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState</Property>
        <Property Name="Assignments">
          <Rows>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_SourceLedger[ModelEntity.VSM_SourceRow].FirstRelease</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">TimeNow</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_LeftReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_LeftReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Left",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
            <Properties>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsStateVariableName">
                <Value>VSM_RightReleasedCount</Value>
              </Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsNewValue">VSM_RightReleasedCount + Math.If(ModelEntity.VSM_ProductTypeState == "Right",ModelEntity.VSM_QuantityState,0)</Property>
              <Property Name="AssignmentsSkipAssignmentCondition"></Property>
            </Properties>
          </Rows>
        </Property>
      </Properties>
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>
processes.VSM_DailyClock:
<Process Name="VSM_DailyClock" BeginStepID="2" Scope="Public" Description="每个有效工作日末先等待同刻正常完工/流转，再分配/盘点；第20日原生EndRun使当前时刻所有事件完成后结束，无额外时间偏移。">
  <Properties>
    <Property Name="ReportStatistics">True</Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventName"></Property>
    <Property Name="TriggeringEventCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="ImmediatelyExecuteCondition"></Property>
    <Property Name="TokenClassName">Token</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectDestroyed">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="TokenActionOnAssociatedObjectTransferRequested">ContinueProcess</Property>
    <Property Name="InitiallyEnabled">True</Property>
    <Property Name="AllowStepTrace">True</Property>
  </Properties>
  <Steps>
    <Step Type="Delay" Name="等待同刻流转完毕" Description="等待同刻流转完毕；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="2">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="DelayType">ForTime</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayTime">Math.Epsilon</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayEndTime">VSM_ClockDay * Math.Round(VSM_WorkdayHours * 3600) / 3600</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayMultiplier">1</Property>
        <Property Name="Interruptible">False</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="3" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Execute" Name="分配到期需求" Description="分配到期需求；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="3">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="ProcessName">
          <Value>VSM_AllocateDemand</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilProcessCompleted</Property>
        <Property Name="CopyTableRowReferencesFromCreatedToken">True</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="10" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Execute" Name="输出当日来源盘点" Description="输出当日来源盘点；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="4">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="ProcessName">
          <Value>VSM_WriteWIPSnapshot</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilProcessCompleted</Property>
        <Property Name="CopyTableRowReferencesFromCreatedToken">True</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="5" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Assign" Name="进入下一工作日" Description="进入下一工作日；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="5">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="StateVariableName">
          <Value>VSM_ClockDay</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="NewValue">VSM_ClockDay+1</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="6" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Decide" Name="仍有工作日" Description="仍有工作日；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="6">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="DecideType">ConditionBased</Property>
        <Property Name="ConditionOrProbability">VSM_ClockDay <= VSM_NumberWorkdays</Property>
        <Property Name="RandomNumberStream">0</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="True" Type="Primary" NextID="7" />
      <Exit Name="False" Type="Alternate" NextID="8" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Delay" Name="等待绝对日末" Description="等待绝对日末；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="7">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="DelayType">UntilTime</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayTime">0</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayEndTime">VSM_ClockDay * Math.Round(VSM_WorkdayHours * 3600) / 3600</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayMultiplier">1</Property>
        <Property Name="Interruptible">False</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="2" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Execute" Name="冻结期末结果" Description="冻结期末结果；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="8">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="ProcessName">
          <Value>VSM_FinalOutputs</Value>
        </Property>
        <Property Name="TokenWaitAction">WaitUntilProcessCompleted</Property>
        <Property Name="CopyTableRowReferencesFromCreatedToken">True</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="9" />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="EndRun" Name="完成本月当前事件" Description="完成本月当前事件；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="9">
      <Properties />
    </Step>
    <Step Type="Delay" Name="等待已交实体退出" Description="等待已交实体退出；按当前业务事件顺序执行。" ID="10">
      <Properties>
        <Property Name="DelayType">ForTime</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayTime">Math.Epsilon</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayEndTime">VSM_ClockDay * Math.Round(VSM_WorkdayHours * 3600) / 3600</Property>
        <Property Name="DelayMultiplier">1</Property>
        <Property Name="Interruptible">False</Property>
      </Properties>
      <Exit Name="Exit" Type="Primary" NextID="4" />
    </Step>
  </Steps>
</Process>

items.description: The time required to process an entity.

items.name: Failure Type
items.description: Specifies whether this object has failures that affect the object's availability, and the method used to trigger the failure occurrences.

items.name: Entered
items.description: Occurs immediately after an entity has entered this object and is about to start the 'Transfer-In Time'.

items.name: Before Processing
items.description: Occurs when an entity has been allocated Server capacity, but before entering (or ending transfer into) its processing station.

items.name: After Processing
items.description: Occurs when an entity has completed the processing time and is about to attempt its exit from the Server's processing station.

items.name: Exited
items.description: Occurs when an entity has exited this object.

items.name: Interarrival Time
items.description: Expression that is evaluated whenever an arrival occurs at this Source object. Indicates the time until the next arrival. This property may be specified using a random sample from a distribution (typically the exponential distribution).

items.name: Entities Per Arrival
items.description: The number of entities that will be created by this Source object for each arrival event.

items.name: Maximum Arrivals
items.description: A limit on the total number of arrivals to be automatically generated by this Source object during the simulation run.

items.name: Report Statistics
items.description: Indicates whether statistics are to be automatically reported for this object or element.

items.name: Interval Type
items.description: The method used to determine the time interval between two successive timer events.

items.name: Time Offset
items.description: Expression that is evaluated once when the timer is initialized or reset. Indicates the time offset until the first timer event.

items.name: Time Interval
items.description: Expression that is evaluated whenever the timer fires its event. Indicates the time until the next timer event.

items.name: Triggered Process Name
items.description: Optional process that executes immediately when the timer's event fires, before any other events scheduled on the simulation's current events calendar.

items.name: Maximum Events
items.description: The maximum number of times after initialization or reset that the timer can fire its event.

items.name: Maximum Time
items.description: The maximum time allowed after initialization or reset that the timer can fire events.

items.name: Reset Event Name
items.description: The name of the event whose occurrence will trigger a reset of the timer.

items.name: Initially Enabled
items.description:
Condition indicating whether the timer is enabled when the system is initialized.

NOTE: Refer to the user-assignable ‘Enabled’ state variable of a timer to dynamically enable or disable it during a simulation run.
